cohort: The study included 1000 premature (case) and full-term (control) neonates born to overweight adolescent mothers.
finding: In premature neonates born to overweight adolescent mothers, RDS was the major complication (78.6%), followed by sepsis (19.9%), IVH (11.3%), PDA (6.6%), and NEC (3.5%), with a neonatal death rate of 4.7%.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was significantly higher in overweight adolescent mothers of premature neonates (64.8%) compared to those with full-term neonates (52.6%).
